method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Both sheets print 'AVE. C. OR MECHANIC' along this corridor. Sheet 21 draws its WEST face, carrying the even Mechanic run 1002,1004,1006,1008,1010,1012 (down to 1028) with the cross-street corner number 223; sheet 22 draws the EAST face with the odd run 1001,1003,1005,1007,1009,1011 (to 1027) and corner number 301. Odd/even opposite faces of the same 1000-block fix the identity. The cross-street hundred also turns here: sheet 21's block runs 202,204,...,224 and sheet 22's runs 302,304,...,324, so 224|302 straddle this line and not the alley one half-block west (detection's candidate 1, native x=2778 on sheet 21, sits in that block interior). One block west is Ave B (Strand), labelled as such on sheet 21 at native x~2160.
